locks: Combat Woodblock historical editorial: clean graphic woodblock blocks, sharp carved sumi-ink contours, large flat registered fields of deep indigo, muted rust, ochre, and jade; a faint warm paper substrate only, never photographic grit or distressed noise
cinematic but stable worlds; communicate movement through character, prop, weather, water, steam, fabric, or distant activity rather than whole-frame camera drift
one clear subject hierarchy with full bodies and props kept inside the frame; avoid accidental limb or object collisions
reserve a calm negative-space anchor for deterministic dates, source treatment, or a cutout learner; generated pixels carry no factual text
do not create readable writing, dates, labels, logos, watermarks, diagrams, or citations; do not invent an identifiable historical likeness
avoid grain, film noise, halftone speckling, cracked texture overlays, faux aged-photo effects, muddy gradients, and busy micro-detail; favor crisp graphic silhouettes and calm clean color fields

chapters.story_world: late nineteenth-century Japan moving from a deliberately mythic battlefield edge into quiet Kodokan courtyards, tatami rooms, study desks, school corridors, and print-advertisement streets
chapters.visual_arc: the audience trades a simplistic origin legend for an institution that selects, teaches, names, and adapts a practice
chapters.entry_motif: rust battlefield smoke resolves into still dawn steam above an orderly gate
chapters.exit_motif: a stamped paper edge becomes an indigo route ribbon leaving Japan
chapters.character_staging: reserve a foot-supported lower-left or lower-right lane for the fictional learner cutout; use anonymous period figures rather than generating Kano's likeness

chapters.story_world: a transnational travel world of steamship decks, tickets, port cranes, newspaper streets, Rio venues, humid Belém riverfronts, theaters, training rooms, and crowded public challenges
chapters.visual_arc: a named traveler enters an already active Brazilian field; movement changes what the audience, venue, instructor, and practice can become
chapters.entry_motif: the Japan route ribbon bends into a ship wake and a carried travel case
chapters.exit_motif: river foam becomes a broad paper-and-ink network weave rather than a single lineage arrow
chapters.character_staging: leave a perspective-safe deck, quay, aisle, or floor lane for the fictional learner or an approved anonymous traveler cutout; never place a cutout on cargo, water, a rail, or a flat foreground object

chapters.story_world: early Brazilian training halls, public posters without readable text, community rooms, city streets, newspaper textures, and a modern-looking archive desk that gathers many overlapping paths without a false family tree
chapters.visual_arc: overlapping communities become a public Brazilian identity through institutions, promotion, memory, and repeated transformation
chapters.entry_motif: a woven river network opens into layered community thresholds and training-room light
chapters.exit_motif: multiple ink routes settle into one open registry folio and a quiet horizon
chapters.character_staging: reserve an uncluttered floor or threshold for the fictional learner; historical figures remain anonymous illustration or approved local archival composites
